dialogs.about: 손주에게 식탁 예절을 알려 주며 저녁을 먹는 이야기

lines.en: Please sit down. Let's say grace first.
Yes, Grandma. Thank you for this dinner.
Good. Please take your elbow off the table.
Sorry. Can you pass me the chopsticks?
Here they are. Do you need a spoon?
Yes, please. I spilled soup this morning.
lines.ko: 네, 주세요. 오늘 아침에 국을 엎질렀어요.

lines.en: It happens. Just hold your bowl carefully.
lines.ko: 그럴 수 있어요. 그릇만 조심해서 잡아요.

lines.en: Is it rude to slurp the noodles?
A little sound is fine at home.
I will remember these manners. Thank you, Grandma.

dialogs.about: 친구 집에 초대받아 식탁에 앉아 나누는 이야기

lines.en: Welcome! Please sit here by the window.
Thank you. What a beautiful tablecloth!
My daughter made it for me last spring.
It is very nice. May I help you?
Please pass the small plates to me.
Here you are. Where are the chopsticks?
They are in that box beside the pot.
lines.ko: 냄비 옆 저 상자 안에 있어요.

lines.en: Is it rude to start before you?
No, please start. Your manners are always good.
Thank you. I will bring a pie next time.
